# Scheduler records and options

> Generated from the code by `scripts/generate-docs-reference.ts`. Do not edit this file: change the code and run `npm run docs:reference`.

What the billing scheduler stores and accepts. The records are plain JSON: a `SchedulerStore` keeps them unchanged. Inputs are shown as a caller passes them (defaults optional); records as the scheduler writes them.

### ScheduleRecord

A subscription whose recurring debits the scheduler raises.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string; not empty | yes | The schedule handle. Defaults to `provider:reference` (see `scheduleIdFor`) and never changes. |
| `provider` | [Provider](enums.md#provider) | yes | The gateway holding the mandate. |
| `subscriptionId` | string; not empty | yes | The id the gateway knows the mandate by; debits are raised against it. Activation may replace it. |
| `reference` | string; not empty | no | The merchant's own reference for the subscription. |
| `status` | one of `pending_authorization`, `active`, `paused`, `cancelled`, `completed`, `halted` | yes | Where the schedule is in its lifecycle. |
| `statusReason` | one of `authorization_timeout`, `authorization_failed`, `mandate_expired`, `cancelled_by_merchant`, `cancelled_by_gateway`, `paused_by_merchant`, `paused_by_gateway`, `halted_by_gateway`, `retries_exhausted`, `all_cycles_collected`, `final_cycle_skipped`, `mandate_ended` | no | Why the schedule is in its current status. |
| `amount` | integer; greater than 0 | yes | Amount in paise of the cycles that have not been notified yet. |
| `currency` | [Currency](enums.md#currency) | yes | Currency of the amount. |
| `interval` | [BillingInterval](models.md#billinginterval) | yes | How often a cycle falls due. |
| `totalCycles` | integer; greater than 0 | no | Number of cycles after which the schedule completes. Omit for open-ended. |
| `mandateEndsAt` | string (date-time) | no | When the mandate lapses. No notification or debit is made for a due date on or after it, and the schedule completes instead. |
| `customer` | [Customer](models.md#customer) | no | The customer, passed along with each debit. |
| `metadata` | map of string to string | no | Merchant metadata, passed along with each debit. |
| `policy` | object | yes | The billing policy of this schedule. |
| `fingerprint` | string | yes | Hash of the registration input, so registering the same data again is a no-op. |
| `firstChargeAt` | string (date-time) | yes | When the first cycle is (or was) due: the end of a free trial or a delayed start. Re-set by activation and re-anchoring before the first debit. |
| `anchorAt` | string (date-time) | yes | Cycle `anchorIndex` is due at this instant; later cycles follow from it. |
| `anchorIndex` | integer; at least 0 | yes | The cycle index that is due at `anchorAt`. |
| `cycleIndex` | integer; at least 0 | yes | The cycle being worked on (0-based). |
| `paidCycles` | integer; at least 0 | yes | Number of cycles collected so far. |
| `retrying` | boolean | yes | True while the current cycle is being retried after a failed debit attempt. |
| `lastFailure` | [LastFailure](#lastfailure) | no | The most recent failed debit attempt of the current cycle. |
| `resumeAt` | string (date-time) | no | While paused: when `tick()` resumes the schedule by itself. |
| `pausedBy` | one of `merchant`, `gateway` | no | While paused: who paused it. A gateway event that resumes the mandate resumes the schedule only when the gateway paused it. |
| `authorizationCheckedAt` | string (date-time) | no | While awaiting authorisation: when `tick()` last asked the gateway about the mandate. |
| `authorizationCheckError` | [CycleError](#cycleerror) | no | While awaiting authorisation: the error the last status check ended with, if it failed. |
| `nextChargeAt` | string (date-time) | no | When the next cycle is due to be debited. Absent when nothing is scheduled (paused, cancelled, completed, halted, awaiting authorisation). |
| `nextActionAt` | string (date-time) | no | When `tick()` next needs to look at this schedule; absent when it needs no attention. The only field the store queries by. |
| `createdAt` | string (date-time) | yes | When the schedule was registered. |
| `updatedAt` | string (date-time) | yes | When the schedule last changed. |
| `activatedAt` | string (date-time) | no | When the customer authorised and billing started. |
| `endedAt` | string (date-time) | no | When the schedule was cancelled, halted or completed. |

### CycleRecord

One billing cycle of a schedule, keyed by `(scheduleId, index)`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `scheduleId` | string | yes | The schedule this cycle belongs to. |
| `index` | integer; at least 0 | yes | 0-based position of the cycle in the schedule. |
| `status` | [CycleStatus](enums.md#cyclestatus) | yes | Where the cycle is in its state machine. |
| `dueAt` | string (date-time) | yes | The cycle's contractual due date, derived from the schedule's anchor. |
| `attemptDueAt` | string (date-time) | yes | Earliest instant the current attempt may be debited: `dueAt` for attempt 1, later for retries. |
| `attempt` | integer; at least 1 | yes | The current attempt, 1-based. Keeps increasing across rounds so charge ids stay unique. |
| `roundStartAttempt` | integer; at least 1 | no | First attempt of the current round of `maxAttempts`; later than 1 after a halted schedule was resumed. |
| `amount` | integer; greater than 0 | no | Amount in paise, frozen when the cycle is first notified or charged, so an amount update never changes a notified cycle. |
| `notificationRound` | integer; at least 1 | yes | Counts re-notifications for the same attempt (a changed debit date needs a fresh notification). |
| `notificationId` | string | no | The id of the pre-debit notification sent for this attempt. |
| `invoiceNumber` | string | no | Invoice number the gateway returned with the notification. |
| `notifiedAt` | string (date-time) | no | When the gateway accepted the pre-debit notification. |
| `debitAt` | string (date-time) | no | The debit date the customer was told. |
| `chargeId` | string | no | Deterministic per (schedule, cycle, attempt), set when charging starts; or the id the gateway dictated with the accepted pre-debit notification (`ChargeNotification.chargeId`), set when the cycle is notified. |
| `providerChargeId` | string | no | The gateway's own id for the debit, once known. |
| `chargeRequestedAt` | string (date-time) | no | When the debit was first requested from the gateway. |
| `chargeSentAt` | string (date-time) | no | When the debit was last sent to the gateway. A debit of unknown outcome is not sent again until `unknownOutcomeGraceMinutes` after this. |
| `scheduledAt` | string (date-time) | no | For gateways that take the charge in advance: the debit date sent to the gateway. Equals `attemptDueAt`, or a later instant when the charge was raised too late to make it. `dueAt` always stays the contractual date. |
| `paidAt` | string (date-time) | no | When the debit was collected. |
| `completedAt` | string (date-time) | no | When the cycle reached a final status. |
| `lastError` | [CycleError](#cycleerror) | no | The last gateway error for this cycle, if any. |
| `attempts` | array of [AttemptRecord](#attemptrecord) | yes | The debit attempts made so far, oldest first. |
| `createdAt` | string (date-time) | yes | When the cycle record was created. |
| `updatedAt` | string (date-time) | yes | When the cycle record last changed. |

### AttemptRecord

One debit attempt of a cycle, kept as history.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `attempt` | integer; at least 1 | yes | 1-based attempt number within the cycle. |
| `chargeId` | string | yes | The debit id sent to the gateway for this attempt. |
| `status` | [ChargeStatus](enums.md#chargestatus) | yes | How the attempt ended. |
| `at` | string (date-time) | yes | When the outcome was recorded. |
| `failureCode` | string | no | The gateway's failure code, when the attempt failed. |
| `failureReason` | string | no | The gateway's failure reason, when the attempt failed. |

### LastFailure

The most recent failed debit attempt of a schedule.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `code` | string | yes | The gateway's failure code. |
| `reason` | string | no | The gateway's failure reason. |
| `at` | string (date-time) | yes | When the attempt failed. |

### CycleError

The last error a gateway call produced for a cycle.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `code` | one of `CONFIG`, `VALIDATION`, `UNSUPPORTED`, `NOT_FOUND`, `AUTH`, `CONFLICT`, `RATE_LIMITED`, `PROVIDER_ERROR`, `PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE`, `UNEXPECTED_RESPONSE`, `NETWORK`, `TIMEOUT`, `OUTCOME_UNKNOWN`, `SIGNATURE_INVALID`, `INTERNAL_ERROR` | yes | Error code of the failed gateway call. |
| `message` | string | yes | Human-readable explanation of the failure. |
| `at` | string (date-time) | yes | When the call failed. |

### SchedulerEvent

A state change of a schedule, handed to the `onEvent` listener after it has been persisted.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | one of `schedule.registered`, `schedule.activated`, `schedule.paused`, `schedule.resumed`, `schedule.cancelled`, `schedule.updated`, `schedule.completed`, `schedule.halted`, `notification.sent`, `notification.failed`, `charge.succeeded`, `charge.failed`, `charge.outcome_unknown`, `charge.outcome_overdue`, `cycle.failed`, `cycle.skipped`, `charge.in_flight` | yes | What happened. |
| `at` | string (date-time) | yes | When it happened. |
| `scheduleId` | string | yes | The schedule it happened to. |
| `provider` | [Provider](enums.md#provider) | yes | The gateway holding the mandate. |
| `subscriptionId` | string | yes | The gateway subscription id of the schedule. |
| `scheduleStatus` | one of `pending_authorization`, `active`, `paused`, `cancelled`, `completed`, `halted` | yes | The status of the schedule after the change. |
| `reason` | one of `authorization_timeout`, `authorization_failed`, `mandate_expired`, `cancelled_by_merchant`, `cancelled_by_gateway`, `paused_by_merchant`, `paused_by_gateway`, `halted_by_gateway`, `retries_exhausted`, `all_cycles_collected`, `final_cycle_skipped`, `mandate_ended` | no | Why the schedule changed status, where relevant. |
| `cycleIndex` | integer; at least 0 | no | The cycle concerned, where relevant. |
| `attempt` | integer; at least 1 | no | The debit attempt concerned, where relevant. |
| `chargeId` | string | no | The debit id concerned, where relevant. |
| `amount` | integer; at least 0 | no | The amount in paise concerned, where relevant. |
| `error` | object | no | The failure, for failure events. |

### SchedulePolicy

Billing policy of one schedule, fixed at registration.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `notifyLeadHours` | number; at least 0 | yes | Send the pre-debit notification this many hours before the due instant. |
| `minNoticeHours` | number; at least 0 | yes | Minimum gap in hours between an accepted notification and the debit. |
| `maxAttempts` | integer; at least 1 | yes | Debit attempts per cycle before the cycle fails and the schedule halts. |
| `retryIntervalHours` | number; at least 0 | yes | Hours to wait between a failed attempt and the next one. |
| `unknownOutcomeGraceMinutes` | number; at least 0 | no | After a debit whose outcome is unknown (no answer, a crash), the same debit id is not submitted again until this many minutes after it was sent; a gateway that does not know the debit yet is asked again on later ticks. Defaults to 30. |
| `chargeLeadHours` | number; at least 0 | no | For gateways that want the charge raised days before the debit (Cashfree on-demand): raise it at least this many hours ahead. The effective lead is the larger of this and the gateway's own `merchantChargeLeadHours`. |
| `authorizationTimeoutHours` | number; greater than 0 | no | A schedule still awaiting authorisation this many hours after it was registered is cancelled by `tick()`. Omit for no timeout. A customer who authorises later still revives it. |
| `authorizationPollMinutes` | number; at least 0 | no | While a schedule awaits the customer's authorisation, `tick()` asks the gateway for the mandate's status at most this often, in minutes, and activates the schedule when the mandate is live (bank mandates such as eNACH confirm hours later and some gateways send no webhook). 0 turns polling off. Defaults to 60. |
| `debitAtIstTime` | string; pattern `^([01]\d\|2[0-3]):([0-5]\d)$` | no | Debit every cycle at this clock time, `HH:mm` in IST, on its due date, instead of at the time of day of the first charge. The first cycle is never moved earlier than its contractual instant. Unset: each cycle falls due at the time of day of the first charge. NPCI restricts UPI Autopay debits during peak hours (10:00 to 13:00 and 17:00 to 21:30 IST), so pick an off-peak time for UPI mandates. |

### SchedulerConfig

Configuration of the billing scheduler: policy defaults and lock timing.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `notifyLeadHours` | number; at least 0, default `48` | no | Default hours before the due instant at which the pre-debit notification is sent. |
| `minNoticeHours` | number; at least 0, default `24` | no | Default minimum gap in hours between an accepted notification and the debit. |
| `maxAttempts` | integer; at least 1, default `3` | no | Default debit attempts per cycle before the schedule halts. |
| `retryIntervalHours` | number; at least 0, default `24` | no | Default hours between a failed attempt and the next one. |
| `unknownOutcomeGraceMinutes` | number; at least 0, default `30` | no | Default minutes to wait after a debit of unknown outcome before submitting the same debit id again. |
| `chargeLeadHours` | number; at least 0 | no | Default charge lead for charge-ahead gateways, in hours. |
| `authorizationTimeoutHours` | number; greater than 0 | no | Default authorisation timeout in hours. Omit for none. |
| `authorizationPollMinutes` | number; at least 0, default `60` | no | While a schedule awaits the customer's authorisation, `tick()` asks the gateway for the mandate's status at most this often, in minutes, and activates the schedule when the mandate is live (bank mandates such as eNACH confirm hours later and some gateways send no webhook). 0 turns polling off. Defaults to 60. |
| `debitAtIstTime` | string; pattern `^([01]\d\|2[0-3]):([0-5]\d)$` | no | Debit every cycle at this clock time, `HH:mm` in IST, on its due date, instead of at the time of day of the first charge. The first cycle is never moved earlier than its contractual instant. Unset: each cycle falls due at the time of day of the first charge. NPCI restricts UPI Autopay debits during peak hours (10:00 to 13:00 and 17:00 to 21:30 IST), so pick an off-peak time for UPI mandates. |
| `lockTtlMs` | integer; greater than 0, default `60000` | no | How long a per-schedule lock survives its owner, in milliseconds. Must exceed the longest time one schedule spends in a tick. |
| `lockWaitMs` | integer; at least 0, default `5000` | no | How long API calls other than `tick` wait for a busy lock before throwing CONFLICT, in milliseconds. |

### RegisterScheduleInput

Registers a schedule for a merchant-scheduled mandate.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string; not empty | no | The schedule handle. Defaults to `provider:reference`, or `provider:subscriptionId` without a reference. |
| `provider` | [Provider](enums.md#provider) | yes | The gateway holding the mandate. |
| `subscriptionId` | string; not empty | yes | The id the gateway knows the mandate by. |
| `reference` | string; not empty | no | The merchant's own reference for the subscription. |
| `amount` | integer; greater than 0 | yes | Amount per cycle, in paise. |
| `currency` | [Currency](enums.md#currency) | no | Currency of the amount. |
| `interval` | [BillingInterval](models.md#billinginterval) | yes | How often a cycle falls due. |
| `firstChargeAt` | string (date-time) | yes | When the first charge is due; for a free trial, the instant the trial ends. |
| `totalCycles` | integer; greater than 0 | no | Number of cycles to bill. Omit to bill until cancelled. |
| `mandateEndsAt` | string (date-time) | no | When the mandate lapses. Must be after `firstChargeAt`. Nothing is notified or debited on or after it. |
| `customer` | [Customer](models.md#customer) | no | The customer, passed along with each debit. |
| `metadata` | map of string to string | no | Merchant metadata, passed along with each debit. |
| `awaitingAuthorization` | boolean | no | Store the schedule as `pending_authorization`; `tick()` ignores it until it is activated. |
| `notifyLeadHours` | number; at least 0 | no | Send the pre-debit notification this many hours before the due instant. |
| `minNoticeHours` | number; at least 0 | no | Minimum gap in hours between an accepted notification and the debit. |
| `maxAttempts` | integer; at least 1 | no | Debit attempts per cycle before the cycle fails and the schedule halts. |
| `retryIntervalHours` | number; at least 0 | no | Hours to wait between a failed attempt and the next one. |
| `unknownOutcomeGraceMinutes` | number; at least 0 | no | After a debit whose outcome is unknown (no answer, a crash), the same debit id is not submitted again until this many minutes after it was sent; a gateway that does not know the debit yet is asked again on later ticks. Defaults to 30. |
| `chargeLeadHours` | number; at least 0 | no | For gateways that want the charge raised days before the debit (Cashfree on-demand): raise it at least this many hours ahead. The effective lead is the larger of this and the gateway's own `merchantChargeLeadHours`. |
| `authorizationTimeoutHours` | number; greater than 0 | no | A schedule still awaiting authorisation this many hours after it was registered is cancelled by `tick()`. Omit for no timeout. A customer who authorises later still revives it. |
| `authorizationPollMinutes` | number; at least 0 | no | While a schedule awaits the customer's authorisation, `tick()` asks the gateway for the mandate's status at most this often, in minutes, and activates the schedule when the mandate is live (bank mandates such as eNACH confirm hours later and some gateways send no webhook). 0 turns polling off. Defaults to 60. |
| `debitAtIstTime` | string; pattern `^([01]\d\|2[0-3]):([0-5]\d)$` | no | Debit every cycle at this clock time, `HH:mm` in IST, on its due date, instead of at the time of day of the first charge. The first cycle is never moved earlier than its contractual instant. Unset: each cycle falls due at the time of day of the first charge. NPCI restricts UPI Autopay debits during peak hours (10:00 to 13:00 and 17:00 to 21:30 IST), so pick an off-peak time for UPI mandates. |

### ActivateScheduleInput

Starts billing once the customer has authorised the mandate.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `subscriptionId` | string; not empty | no | Replaces the stored gateway subscription id (the schedule's own id stays the same). |
| `firstChargeAt` | string (date-time) | no | Replaces the anchor. Without it, a past anchor becomes the activation instant. |

### PauseScheduleInput

Options for pausing a schedule.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `resumeAt` | string (date-time) | no | Resume billing by itself at this instant (the next `tick()` after it). Must be in the future. Omit to stay paused until resumed. |

### ResumeScheduleInput

Options for resuming a paused or halted schedule.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `nextChargeAt` | string (date-time) | no | When the next cycle is due. Without it the schedule continues unchanged, or from now if the pause swallowed the due date. |
| `skipFailedCycle` | boolean | no | For a halted schedule whose current cycle failed: skip that cycle and continue from the next one, instead of re-opening it for another round of attempts. |

### UpdateScheduleInput

Changes the billing terms of a live schedule.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `amount` | integer; greater than 0 | no | New amount per cycle in paise, for cycles that have not been notified yet. |
| `nextChargeAt` | string (date-time) | no | Move the next debit to this instant; later cycles follow from it. A pre-debit notice already sent for the old date is redone. |
| `remainingCycles` | integer; greater than 0 | no | Debits still to be collected, counting the current cycle. Sets the total to paid cycles plus this. |
| `mandateEndsAt` | string (date-time) | no | New mandate end date. No notification or debit is made for a due date on or after it. |

### CancelScheduleInput

Options for cancelling a schedule.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `reason` | one of `authorization_timeout`, `authorization_failed`, `mandate_expired`, `cancelled_by_merchant`, `cancelled_by_gateway`, `paused_by_merchant`, `paused_by_gateway`, `halted_by_gateway`, `retries_exhausted`, `all_cycles_collected`, `final_cycle_skipped`, `mandate_ended` | no | Why the schedule is cancelled. Defaults to `cancelled_by_merchant`. |

### TickOptions

Options for one run of the billing scheduler.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | integer; at least 1, default `100` | no | Maximum schedules examined in this tick. |
| `concurrency` | integer; at least 1, default `5` | no | Schedules processed in parallel. |
